name: The 3rd Army's defence of Pannonia, by adversary
status: F3.1 (20 Nov 2026): data only (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md sections 3.1, 5.2 and 11). Nothing reads it on the campaign path until F3.3; simcore/ground_war/ground_data.hpp loads it and tests/test_ground_data.cpp checks it.
source: our doctrine from the ČSLA's 1985 regulations as previewed (vr_poltikovic_1984, vr_krizek_1985) and the Pact's texts (reznichenko_1984, mt_stashek_losses, mt_novoselov_replacement), docs/research/fronts_2026-11/our_side.md; the deployments are SAM3D estimates on the country map (data/maps/pannonia.json) for the order of battle data/command/oob_pannonia.json
notes: One enemy at a time: each deployment says which formations face that adversary's front and where. A deployment's stretch is from_km to to_km along the front's line in the nation's theatre (data/air_war/theatre_pannonia_nation.json, FrontDef::line), the same measure as F2.1's sectors, so it stays valid when F1 anchors the line. Units not listed stay in their garrisons. equipment_fill gives equipment to oob_pannonia.json's units that have none, as labelled estimates; the order of battle file itself is not changed (its readers stay as they are until F3.3).

equipment_fill.source: estimate (SAM3D): a Pact-pattern motor rifle regiment of 1985 on older equipment, a tank battalion, three motor rifle battalions and an artillery battalion (of the order of fm100_2_3's view of the Soviet regiment)
estimate (SAM3D): as mrr_71, on wheeled carriers
estimate (SAM3D): the south-western group's brigade, a tank battalion, two motor rifle battalions and its artillery (sw_artillery)

pool.source: game value: our commanders drawn as the air war's officers are; a Pact-trained army, by the regulations, withdrawal and counterattack on the senior's order (reznichenko_1984)

authored.name: Rudolf Kral
authored.bio: The 7th Division's commander (data/command/chain_pannonia.json div_commander). Careful with his regiments; asks early for permission he expects to be refused.

doctrine.source: docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 5.2 from docs/research/fronts_2026-11/our_side.md and pact_ground.md

attack_ratio.source: fm_100_2_1_1984 p. 2-11: a Pact-trained army's counterattack at about 3:1 (our side follows the Pact's norms)

withdraw_needs_order.source: reznichenko_1984 pp. 49, 152; voenizdat_osa_1991 p. 238: only with the senior commander's permission

counterattack_by_senior.source: reznichenko_1984 pp. 177-179; vr_poltikovic_1984 p. 96: the next higher commander's; the second echelon from the march into the flank, tanks leading, to a set line

counterattack_stops_at_border.source: SAM3D estimate: the owner's open decision 4 taken as proposed (docs/fronts/README.md); restoring the state border is among the ČSLA's 1985 counterstrike aims (vr_svatos_1985)

breakthrough.source: mt_kurkov_tank_army p. 9; fm_100_2_1_1984 p. 4-4 (the Pact's norms our army was trained to)

frontages_km.source: estimate (SAM3D): between the regiment's and the division's (vr_poltikovic_1984 pp. 95-96)

depth_km.source: vr_poltikovic_1984 p. 96; vr_krizek_1985 pp. 32-36: the army sets its depth, the division runs it and orders each withdrawal

delay_per_line_h.source: vr_krizek_1985 pp. 32-36: a reinforced battalion delays a brigade 1-2 h a line

restore_control_h.source: mt_stashek_losses: about 1 h through a forward command post, otherwise 2-3 h

security_zone_km.source: SAM3D estimate within vr_poltikovic_1984 p. 96's 20-40 km: the army's choice against a peer's main thrust

deployments.source: SAM3D estimate: the 7th Division on the Rava gorge and Dravec (battery 21 covers the dam's approach, the nation's theatre's battery_position), the 9th on the north-eastern road, the south-western brigade screening Hradec, the tank brigade the army's reserve by the capital

security_zone_km.source: SAM3D estimate within vr_poltikovic_1984 p. 96's 20-40 km

deployments.source: SAM3D estimate: the 9th Division on the western road (its peacetime western group), the south-western brigade south of the Lenta, the 7th Division in the second echelon by Novo Varosd (battery 21 covers the hub behind, the nation's theatre's battery_position), the tank brigade the army's reserve

security_zone_km.source: SAM3D estimate: a line against rebels has no deep security zone, only outposts

deployments.source: SAM3D estimate: the 7th Division's southern regiments hold the line in the valley (battery 21 covers the southern group's forward troops), its tank regiment behind at Kesmark

security_zone_km.source: SAM3D estimate at vr_poltikovic_1984 p. 96's shallow end: a limited war on a short front

deployments.source: SAM3D estimate: the south-western brigade and the 72nd Regiment (its peacetime south-western group; battery 21 covers it) on the border, the 9th Division behind, the tank brigade the army's reserve at Saldanj
